metadata.title: Emergency Notification System SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan governing institution-wide emergency notification across email, SMS, and voice channels for life-safety and critical operational events.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security, privacy, resiliency, and life-safety baseline.

system-characteristics.system-description: Institutionally governed, multi-channel emergency notification capability used to disseminate time-critical alerts related to life safety, security incidents, or essential operational continuity.

information-type.title: Emergency Notification Content
information-type.description: Time-sensitive emergency alert messages distributed across one or more channels.

information-type.title: Emergency Recipient Lists
information-type.description: Authoritative institutional population data used for emergency alert distribution.

information-type.title: Emergency Notification Audit Events
information-type.description: Audit trails for message authorization, dispatch, delivery outcomes, and suppression decisions.

props.name: depends-on-sspp
props.remarks: Email delivery relies on Secure Email Platform protections and monitoring.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Email channel uses the Application Notification pattern with emergency-specific constraints.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Dedicated emergency email domains enforce strict SPF, DKIM, and DMARC.

props.name: usage-intent
props.remarks: This system is restricted to life-safety incidents and critical institutional emergencies.

props.name: authority-scope
props.remarks: Emergency notifications may only be issued by designated authorities with institution-wide responsibility.

props.name: authorized-sender-groups
props.remarks: Only formally designated emergency authorities may initiate notifications.

props.name: communication-model
props.remarks: Emergency notifications are one-way alerts; replies are not supported.

props.name: directionality
props.remarks: Email is used strictly for outbound emergency alerts; inbound processing is prohibited.

props.name: reply-capability
props.remarks: Replies, delegation, and conversational use are prohibited.

props.name: email-recipient-policy
props.remarks: Emergency email may be sent to both institutional and external email addresses as required for safety.

props.name: recipient-source
props.remarks: Recipient populations are derived from authoritative institutional data sources.

props.name: subdomain-isolation
props.remarks: Emergency email uses a dedicated subdomain with isolated reputation and DMARC enforcement.

props.name: dmarc-policy
props.remarks: DMARC enforcement is mandatory for emergency email to prevent impersonation.

props.name: automation-constraint
props.remarks: Notifications may be initiated only through authorized emergency workflows or systems.

props.name: opt-out-policy
props.remarks: Opt-out from emergency notifications is not permitted.

props.name: escalation-and-priority
props.remarks: Emergency notifications may override standard throttling and suppression controls.

props.name: data-classification-constraint
props.remarks: Emergency notifications must not include information classified above Level 2.

props.name: auditability
props.remarks: All emergency notification actions must be fully logged and reviewable.

props.name: misuse-prohibition
props.remarks: Use of the emergency notification system for non-emergency purposes is prohibited.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Emergency notifications require assured delivery, prioritization, and recovery under adverse conditions consistent with cyber resiliency guidance.

system-implementation.remarks: The Emergency Notification System operates as a dedicated, high-priority alerting capability with multi-channel delivery and strong sender authority enforcement.

components.title: Emergency Notification Platform
components.description: Multi-channel emergency alerting platform integrating email, voice, and SMS delivery.

roles.title: Emergency Notification Authority
roles.remarks: Authorized to initiate institution-wide emergency notifications.

roles.title: Emergency Communications Operations
roles.remarks: Operates and validates emergency notification tooling and workflows.

control-implementation.remarks: All security and privacy controls are inherited from Secure Email Platform SSPP and Emergency Notification System-specific governance and authority constraints.
